## 🔒 ALLOWED_EMAILS not enforced when signing in with Google, Microsoft or OIDC

**Who is affected.** Self-hosted instances that set `ALLOWED_EMAILS` and also offer Google, Microsoft or OIDC login. Instances that only use email login, or that don't set `ALLOWED_EMAILS`, are not affected.

**The bug.** `ALLOWED_EMAILS` was only checked when someone signed in with an email code. Signing in through Google, Microsoft or OIDC skipped the check, so anyone with an account at one of those providers could reg

## 🐛 Poll times saved an hour off around daylight saving changes

**The bug.** When adding times to a poll, the time saved could be an hour later than the one you picked. It happened in two cases:

- The week contained a daylight saving change. For example, in a Chicago week starting on the Nov 1 2026 clock change, clicking the 10:00 AM row on Tue Nov 3 created an 11:00 AM option.
- Your browser's time zone was different from the poll's, and one of them changed its clocks on that day. You could pick

## Node.js security update

This release rebuilds the image on Node.js 24.22.1, which fixes CVE-2026-111497, a remote code execution in the Brotli decoder, along with several high severity TLS and DNS issues from the [October 2026 Node.js security releases](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/october-2026-security-releases). The 4.16.1 image and every earlier one run an affected Node.js version. Upgrade by pulling the new image and restarting the container.

The base image is now pinned to `node:24.22.
- Email link scanners such as Safe Links no longer open a database connection for every link they check. (#3571)

- **Database:** 13 migrations run on start. None of them removes data: they add tables, columns and indexes, and a safeguard that keeps every space owner a member of their space (restoring any owner membership that went missing). As always, back up before upgrading.
